message: Done, integrated with the final sim-drenaje ensemble (126 runs). Image grid unchanged so labels.png is identical; tools/prep.mjs re-run only refreshed board.json from the republished AGEB profile (same AGEB order, #plan links and demo targets unchanged). Gap classes follow the 5% rule (fallback aggregation updated too). population_benefit_0_to_40 now marks where a colector is worth it: 40 dashed-outline candidates when the colector is selected, 'top 10/40 drenaje' tag, rank + storm-inlet note in the inspector; demo colector restricted to top-60 (still Jardines de San José, #3). Final numbers: ~692k people exposed at 20 mm/h; reference greedy plan 48,092 people for 1,998 MDP (~$41.5k/person), 0.3% of benefit in high/very-high marginación AGEBs vs 12.6% of the exposed; demo ends at 5,063 people / $192 M / 6% equity. window.__cauceDemo API unchanged (duration_s 25, ready, seek, steps); demo seeked 0-25 s on W10 without console errors. screenshot.jpg retaken on W10.
